chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who became junub and then performed ghusl before urinating, and then something came out of him. He said: “He repeats the ghusl.” I said: Then if a woman has something come out of her after ghusl? He said: “She does not repeat.” I said: Then what is the difference between them? He said: “Because what comes out of the woman is only from the man’s fluid.”
ai.seo_question: Does a person have to repeat ghusl if something comes out after ghusl al-janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ghusl after janabah when discharge appears afterward. It distinguishes between a man and a woman, stating that the man repeats the ghusl in the described case, while the woman does not, because what exits from her is regarded here as the man’s fluid.
